question: In a certain code language, if FINALIZE is written as JKRCPKDG, then how will INSIGNIA be written in the same code language?
solution:
The logic follows here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/cSG2P91Ha3QW8BQ7UDEMQLRZ_7-zbb9YG9CUGduD0TfUit5W0zTlSUHL9d46P6uwyWANO8JB-jUPNWpZocnvHKDxTRzwZcCCzK01enKpqolBfIvg7tjU9e44pNJ8hnEGURFbaTjw] 

**Vowels : A, E, I, O, U**

The logic followed here is:** **

**Each vowels are increased by +2.**

 
• **Vowel + 2**

**Each consonants are increased by +4.**

 
• **Consonant + 4**

FINALIZE is written as JKRCPKDG is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20fe5093192e3e44e48987eba8ece891a049f4adfca433de767595a3c8cebc9b.png] 

Similarly,

INSIGNIA will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bec90269dcb425f6e2ec76ad496bd801593dc484bbb2cd6743696aefea8e0b4.png] 

Thus, the correct answer is **"KRWKKRKC".**
